changes.title: Snooze on e
items: One wake-up every morning: E (□ on a pad) snoozes the alarm, and a step gets her up after a stretch, after a reload, the bed or a sail too
E no longer gets her straight out of bed

changes.title: Smoother landing
items: Landing on a new island no longer stutters while its trees arrive: the forest is redrawn a little each frame instead of all at once

changes.title: First morning hat
items: The first morning of a game has no pile of last night's clothes, even if you've played before: your hat waits on the hats' floor and the pins show you round the wardrobe, shoes, cloak, bags and hats. After a night, last night's clothes and hat are in the pile as before
